# arianet_server (Data Source)

One existing server, by `id`, `name` or `label_selector`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "arianet_server" "db" {
  name = "db-1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Server ID.
- `label_selector` (String) Label selector that must match exactly one server.
- `name` (String) Server name.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time.
- `datacenter` (String) Datacenter.
- `disk_gb` (Number) Disk size.
- `image` (String) Image it was created from.
- `ipv4_address` (String) Public IPv4.
- `ipv6_address` (String) Public IPv6.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels.
- `plan_id` (Number) Plan ID.
- `project_id` (Number) Project.
- `protection_delete` (Boolean) Delete protection.
- `status` (String) Status.
